Welcome to the official YouTube channel of Dr. Jon Saunders, BKin, DC – your trusted source for natural health information. Based in Newmarket, Ontario, I’m in private practice with over 25 years of experience in chiropractic, kinesiology, fitness, and rehabilitation.

Get expert tips on:
• Neck pain, back pain, and sciatica
• Cervicogenic dizziness, vertigo, and headaches
• Posture correction and spinal decompression
• Neck strengthening and disc bulge relief
• Natural health, nutrition, and biomechanics

My goal is to help you move better, feel better, and live pain-free—without drugs or surgery.

Subscribe for weekly videos and take control of your health today.
